generic.security_warning_contact_support: If you did not initiate this action, please contact us by emailing support@couchers.org so we can sort this out as soon as possible!
generic.do_not_reply_request: Do not reply to this email. Use one of the buttons above to reply to this request.

account_deletion_started.confirmation_instructions: To complete this process, please confirm by clicking the following button:

account_deletion_completed.confirmation: You have successfully deleted your account from Couchers.org.
account_deletion_completed.farewell: We are sad to see you go, and wish you the best in your future travels. You are always welcome back on the Couchers.org platform :)

account_deletion_recovered.confirmation: Your account on Couchers.org has been successfully recovered!
account_deletion_recovered.login_instructions: We are so glad you decided to stay! To log back in, click the following link:
account_deletion_recovered.redelete_instructions: If you change your mind, you can delete your account at any time.

api_key_issued.subject: Your API key for Couchers.org
api_key_issued.header: You recently requested an API key for Couchers.org. We've issued you with the following API key:
api_key_issued.usage_warning: This API key is unique to your account; do not share it with anyone, it gives complete access to your account, and you are reponsible for any actions taken using this API key.
api_key_issued.policy_warning: Please remember to abide by our Terms of Service, our Community Guidelines, and other policies while using our APIs. All access is logged and analyzed, and we may terminate your access or account if you abuse the service.

host_my_home_nudge.subject: Get ready to host a couch surfer
host_my_home_nudge.preview: Travellers are looking for a host in your area — finish your My Home section to start showing up.
host_my_home_nudge.intro: You signed up as someone who's open to hosting on Couchers.org, and there are travellers passing through who would love to stay with you.
host_my_home_nudge.details: The last step before surfers can find you and send you a request is your "My Home" section: a bit about your place, how many guests you can take, and your sleeping arrangement.
host_my_home_nudge.closing: It only takes a couple of minutes, and once it's done you'll start showing up to people searching to stay in your area.

phone_number_verified.body: Your phone was successfully verified as {{ phone_number }}.

postal_verification_failed.subject: Postal Verification failed
postal_verification_failed.reason_code_expired: Your verification code has expired. Codes are valid for 90 days after the postcard is sent. You can start a new verification attempt.
postal_verification_failed.reason_too_many_attempts: Too many incorrect code attempts. You can start a new verification attempt.
postal_verification_failed.reason_unknown: Your postal verification attempt has failed. You can start a new verification attempt.

postal_verification_postcard_sent.subject: Your verification postcard is on its way
postal_verification_postcard_sent.body: We've sent a postcard with your verification code to {{ city }}, {{ country }}. It should arrive within 1-3 weeks depending on your location. Once it arrives, enter the code on the platform to complete verification.

postal_verification_succeeded.subject: Postal Verification succeeded
postal_verification_succeeded.body: You have been verified with Postal Verification! Your address has been confirmed.

strong_verification_failed.subject: Strong Verification failed
strong_verification_failed.reason_wrong_birthdate_or_gender: The date of birth or gender on your profile does not match the date of birth or sex on your passport. Please contact the support team to update your date of birth or gender, or if your passport sex does not match your gender identity.
strong_verification_failed.reason_not_a_passport: You tried to verify with a document that is not a passport. You can only use a passport for Strong Verification.
strong_verification_failed.reason_duplicate: You tried to verify with a passport that has already been used for verification. Please use another passport.

strong_verification_succeeded.subject: Strong Verification succeeded
strong_verification_succeeded.success_message: You have been verified with Strong Verification! You will now see a tick next to your name on the platform.
strong_verification_succeeded.thanks_message: Thanks for verifying—you're helping make Couchers.org safer for everyone.
strong_verification_succeeded.cost_explanation: Verification is free for you, but it does come at a cost to us. As a nonprofit run by volunteers, we rely on donations to cover expenses like keeping our servers running, verification, and tools for volunteers and community builders.
strong_verification_succeeded.donation_request: If you're able, please consider donating to help keep Couchers.org running and growing.
